slides.text: Silence feels uncomfortable. You need noise to eat.
No phone for the first hour you're awake.
One walk today. No earbuds. Just think and pray.
slides.sub: Let your mind get quiet again.

slides.title: WHO YOU SPEND YOUR WEEKEND WITH IS YOUR FUTURE

slides.text: Every plan to grow gets laughed off by Saturday night.
slides.sub: You become the average of the room.

slides.text: Prays for you and asks how it's going.
Tells you when you're slipping. Kindly, but clearly.
Texts you at 6 AM: “you coming?”
Talks about ideas and plans, not other people.
Ten years further down the road. Ask questions.
“He that walketh with wise men shall be wise…”

slides.title: DO THIS MONEY CHECK BEFORE THE HOLIDAYS HIT

slides.text: December spending decides what January feels like.
slides.sub: No plan is still a plan.

slides.text: Needs. Wants. Savings and debt. A simple starting guide.
Add up last month: needs, wants, saved.
Set a holiday number now. Write it down.
Schedule a transfer to savings on payday.
slides.sub: Even small amounts build the habit.

slides.text: “Be thou diligent to know the state of thy flocks…”

slides.title:
CHECK IT TODAY.
NOT MONDAY.

scenes.cap: MOST OF US FORGET. NOT ON PURPOSE.
5 MINUTES A DAY. PRAY THE LIST.

slides.title: STAY UP LATE TONIGHT AND SUNDAY IS GONE
slides.sub: Sleep is a stat. Level it up →

slides.text: Groggy at church. Wasted Sunday. Tired Monday.
slides.sub: One late night costs three days.

slides.text: Pick a bedtime tonight. Set an alarm for it.
Dim the room 30 minutes before bed.
Charge your phone outside the bedroom.
Wake at your normal time tomorrow. Even Sunday.
“…for so he giveth his beloved sleep.”
slides.sub: Rest is a gift. Take it.
